description: This source file contains an extension for the FileHandle class, providing safer versions of read methods that throw exceptions instead of causing Objective-C exceptions on error or EOF.

methods.name: readToEndSafely
methods.description: Reads until EOF using the throwing FileHandle API, returning empty Data on failure.

methods.name: readSafely(upToCount:)
methods.description: Reads up to a specified number of bytes using the throwing API, returning empty Data on failure or EOF.
